title: fix(runtime): the package doors record the signed-in caller in metadata history, never a body actor
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxRq6Zajh1nP3XTr94KdhQ3e)_
Fixes #28414

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:丢弃草稿、撤销提交、回滚、收编孤儿元数据、复制这五个包操作,以及发布草稿时重新保存应用的那一步,现在都把登录用户记进元数据历史和包提交,不再采用请求体里填的 `actor`。
- 为什么改:之前持有 `manage_metadata` 的人可以在请求体里填别人的名字,历史里就显示成别人改的;管理员靠这份记录决定回滚什么、找谁问。
- 风险与回滚:请求体 `actor` 只是被忽略,不会被拒绝,老调用照常工作;系统调用(没有用户)跟以前一样不记 actor。没有数据迁移,回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`(六处调用改用 `resolvePackageWriteActor`,以及该函数头注释)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-write-actor-session.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-write-actor-session.test.ts`,预期 17 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Runtime (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`).** Six protocol calls that passed `body.actor` straight through now record the user id of the request's authorized execution context, through `resolvePackageWriteActor`:

- `POST /packages/:id/discard-drafts` → `discardPackageDrafts`
- `POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert` → `revertCommit`
- `POST /packages/:id/rollback` → `rollbackToPackageCommit`
- `POST /packages/:id/adopt-orphans` → `reassignOrphanedMetadata`
- `POST /packages/:id/duplicate` → `duplicatePackage`
- the ADR-0045 app re-save inside `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` → `saveMetaItem`. It reuses the `actor` that door already resolves for its own publish.

A body `actor` is ignored, not refused. A context with no user id (a system caller) sends no `actor`, so the protocol records the actor-less `null` (#4556), as it did before for a body without one.

**Shared helper owner: #28406 (PR #28422).** N-06 landed first, so it owns `resolvePackageWriteActor`. This PR consumes it and adds no second helper. Its docblock no longer says "only publish-drafts reads it today"; it now lists every door that reads it.

**SDK (`packages/client/src/index.ts`).** The `actor` member of the inline `opts` object types on `packages.discardDrafts`, `packages.revertCommit`, `packages.rollback`, `packages.adoptOrphans` and `packages.duplicate` is marked `@deprecated` (the server ignores it). This matches what #28422 did for `packages.publishDrafts`. No type changes shape and no export is added or removed, hence `Clause-②: no`.

**Spec (Wanted 3): no diff.** No `packages/spec` request schema declares `actor` for these doors. `package-lifecycle.zod.ts` holds only response transcriptions; the route ledger names no `requestSchema` for them; `PublishPackageDraftsRequestSchema` (#28447) already strips `actor`. With nothing to drop or mark, there is no spec change, no regenerated artifact, and `Metadata-protocol: none`. The claim's `Clause-②: yes` line assumed a spec hunk that does not exist.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-write-actor-session.test.ts` (new, 17 cases), driving `dispatch()` over a real `SchemaRegistry` and a recording protocol:
  - For each of the five doors: a body naming another user records the session user; a body naming no one records the session user; a system context sends no `actor`, with or without a body `actor`.
  - The publish-drafts app re-save: a body naming another user re-saves the app as the session user; a system context sends no `actor`.
- Two existing pins flipped to the fixed behaviour:
  - `http-dispatcher.test.ts`, the commit-revert routing case, expected the body's `ai:claude`. It now expects the session user.
  - `packages-publish-drafts-request-conformance.test.ts` (#28447) pinned "the app re-save still forwards a body `actor`" and said to flip it when this card landed. Flipped to `USER`. The route-ledger row note carried no sentence about it, so nothing there changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Wanted 2, on-behalf-of callers: none found.** The console sends `{}` or no body on all five doors (`PackagesPage.tsx`, `commitHistory.ts`, `packages-io.ts`). The SDK sends `opts` only when given, and no in-repo caller passes `actor`. The CLI calls none of these routes. ADR-0008 and ADR-0067 describe `recorded_by` holding an AI principal such as `ai:claude` for an AI apply's commit. That commit is written server-side by the protocol and is untouched here; only fixtures sent `ai:claude` through these HTTP doors.
- **Premise correction:** the card's `:2074 → saveMetaItem` is not a seventh door. It is the app re-save inside the publish-drafts handler. #28422 left it reading `body.actor` (its own conformance pin said so), and this PR closes it.
- The merge commit `881d0d31` was committed with the repo hook path overridden by mistake, so `.githooks/pre-commit` did not run on it. Its only check, `node scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs`, was run by hand right after: exit 0. No generated artifact is in this diff.

## Verification

Readings at head `4f64ab7c` unless stated. `fea2382b` differs from it only by a test-file comment.

The one failure was the #28447 pin above, flipped in `fea2382b`. That file plus the new file and `http-dispatcher.test.ts` at `fea2382b`: 3 files, 276 tests passed.
- New file at `4f64ab7c`: 17 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client test` at `881d0d31`: Test Files 53 passed, Tests 689 passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` at `fea2382b`: VERDICT command-exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client typecheck` at `881d0d31`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide) at `fea2382b`: exit 0. eslint `--no-inline-config` on the changed test file at `4f64ab7c`: exit 0.

</details>

Tests import `src/` relatively, so no dist rebuild sits between mutation and run. At `fea2382b`:

- publish-drafts app re-save → 2 failed / 15 passed (its two cases)
- discard-drafts → 3 failed / 14 passed. The first attempt's anchor matched twice (the publish call has the same two lines) and was refused before any write. The rerun with a three-line anchor landed.

Each leg reds exactly its own door's cases.

After `git fetch --unshallow` and a full `pnpm build` (VERDICT command-exit 0) at `fea2382b`, all three exit 0.
